Name: Northwest Coast
Author: MK215
Description:
[center]You always dreamed of getting a fast way to get clay in early game?
Collect berries in an area next to your farm? And to have a few extra forages? 

[b][font=Georgia]Visit the Northwest Coast!
[/font][/b]
A beautiful coast on the ocean with cliffs.
You can find clay, a good amount of bushes with berries,
seasonal forage, and ocean items that can be foraged.

[i]Should be compatible with most other mods.
(yes, also with SVE, Ridgeside valley, ... )
[/i][/center]

Downloads.Description: one easter egg was added, fixed the clay spawn rate and removed the black boarder
